scope: automatic private-state invalidation after authenticated storefront API returns HTTP 401

failures: buyer client returned StorefrontApiError 401 but did not notify invalidation listeners
buyer preferences, draft and dark preview remained visible after save returned 401
administrator Atlas proposal remained visible after approve returned 401

assertions: the triggering request preserves its StorefrontApiError status, code and safe message for the caller
HTTP 401 increments transport generation, drops cached and pending session state, aborts active requests and synchronously notifies listeners
buyer preferences and draft disappear immediately and the opt-in root returns to defaults
a concurrent response that resolves after the 401 is rejected as AbortError and cannot repopulate private state

note: No new dependency, endpoint, authority or browser storage was introduced. Explicit clearSession and server 401 now share the same finite invalidation path.
